full_judgment: "a person who, from the discovery of new and important matter or evidence which, after the exercise of due diligence, was not within his knowledge or could not be produced by him at the time when the decree was passed or order made or on account of some mistakes or error apparent on the face of the records or for any sufficient reason, desires to obtain a review of the decree passed or order made against him, may apply for a review of the judgment to the court which passed the decree or made the order."
